title: Bridging the Closed-World Gap: Interpretable Anomaly Detection via a Hybrid TSK-FCM Ensemble on the BETH Dataset
abstract: arXiv:2610.30576v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A fundamental paradox plagues the deployment of Machine Learning in cybersecurity: supervised models generalize poorly to novel, Out-of-Distribution (OoD) attacks, whereas unsupervised models often suffer from poor separability, leading to unmanageable false-alarm rates. This challenge is exemplified by the BETH dataset, a kernel-level benchmark in which the training data consists solely of benign and suspicious insider behaviors, whereas the test set consists almost entirely of novel botnet activation attacks. To bridge this detection gap, we propose a Hybrid Fuzzy Ensemble that synergizes the precision of supervised learning with the adaptability of unsupervised clustering. Our architecture integrates a gradient-optimized Takagi-Sugeno-Kang (TSK) fuzzy classifier to act as an expert on known insider threats, with a parallel Fuzzy C-Means (FCM) module to detect geometric anomalies. translated_title: 弥合封闭世界差距：基于TSK-FCM混合集成方法在BETH数据集上的可解释异常检测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.30576v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：机器学习在网络安全部署中面临一个根本性的悖论：监督学习模型对新颖的分布外攻击泛化能力较差，而无监督模型往往存在可分性差的问题，导致误报率难以控制。BETH数据集正是这一挑战的典型例证，这是一个内核级基准数据集，其训练数据仅包含良性和可疑的内部行为，而测试集几乎完全由新颖的僵尸网络激活攻击组成。为了弥合这一检测差距，我们提出了一种混合模糊集成方法，将监督学习的精确性与无监督聚类的适应性协同结合。我们的架构集成了一个梯度优化的Takagi-Sugeno-Kang（TSK）模糊分类器，作为已知内部威胁的检测专家，并与一个并行的模糊C均值（FCM）模块协同工作以检测几何异常。我们研究的一个关键发现是，传统……
tldr: 提出了一种将梯度优化TSK模糊分类器与FCM聚类模块协同结合的混合模糊集成方法，在BETH数据集上实现了既能精确检测已知内部威胁、又能发现新型几何异常的可解释异常检测，从而弥合监督与无监督学习之间的封闭世界差距。
en_tdlr: A hybrid fuzzy ensemble combining a gradient-optimized TSK fuzzy classifier for known insider threats with a parallel FCM clustering module for geometric anomalies, achieving interpretable anomaly detection that bridges the closed-world gap on the BETH dataset.
